chapters.title: Where you go, I will go
chapters.summary: During a famine, Naomi loses her husband and two sons in Moab. Her daughter-in-law Ruth refuses to leave her and returns with her to Bethlehem: your people shall be my people.

chapters.title: Ruth gleans in Boaz's field
chapters.summary: Ruth gathers leftover grain in the field of Boaz, a relative of Naomi, who treats her with kindness and protection.

chapters.title: At the threshing floor
chapters.summary: At Naomi's urging, Ruth goes to Boaz at night and asks him to act as her kinsman-redeemer. Boaz promises to do so if a closer relative declines.

chapters.title: Boaz redeems Ruth
chapters.summary: Boaz settles the matter at the city gate and marries Ruth. Their son Obed brings Naomi joy and becomes the grandfather of King David.
